matter_source_note: The only admissible matter ids are ids actually defined by the canonical Matter catalog. This file records explicit bindings; it never adds, edits or overrides Matter truth.

rules.statement: Every binding.matter_id MUST be an id defined in matter_source_of_truth at validation time.
A binding whose matter_id is absent from the canonical Matter catalog MUST fail validation.
A matter_id bound to more than one surface family, or to more than one surface inside a family, MUST fail validation.
For BOUND families, the canonical Matter 'family' of the bound material MUST be listed in the taxonomy family expected_matter_families; otherwise the physical binding is ambiguous and MUST fail.
A family with binding_status PENDING_CANONICAL_MATTER MUST have zero bindings and MUST be listed in pending_families with a concrete reason and unblock condition.
Surface families and bindings are presentation-only metadata. They MUST NOT define physical material properties, strata depth or Matter lifecycle; WORLD PACKS never mutates Matter truth.

bindings.rationale: Loose granular regolith mantle is the canonical loose-phase member of the regolith surface family.
Compacted regolith is the canonical consolidated member of the regolith surface family.
Coherent basalt is the canonical member of the basaltic rock surface family.
Fractured basalt is the fractured member of the basaltic rock surface family.
Water ice is the canonical member of the ice surface family.

pending_families.reason: No canonical matter/sand id exists in matter_material_catalog; binding matter/regolith-loose or matter/silicate-waste as sand would be an ambiguous physical binding.
pending_families.unblock: Canonical Matter ownership introduces a sand/granular matter id; then bind it explicitly here.

explicitly_unbound_matter.reason: Metallic ore surface family is out of WP-SURFACE1 scope; no surface descriptor claims it.
Processed waste is not a natural geological surface family; no surface descriptor claims it.
